title: max_concurrent as sqrt(embark size in region tiles)+1: the tool's land groups at once at the default 3 vs the formula (4x4: 5; 6x6: 7) on fresh 7-dwarf embarks on CTRL's tile (preset, rotation on). Surface wild groups on the map (species x population), wild units and t/s per sample.
fork: does raising the limit with embark size raise the concurrent groups (and cost speed)?

predictions.model: the tool's gate is the binding limit
predictions.expects: formula arms carry more concurrent groups than the default arms
the same concurrent groups either way

kill_criterion: mean concurrent groups within 0.5 between arms on both forts
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: FPS2E4_groups3
pre: dfhack.run_command('seasonal-wildlife','quota','land','3'); dfhack.run_command('seasonal-wildlife','enable'); local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local c=sw.loadConfig(); print(('eco: enabled=%s land groups=%s max_concurrent=%s'):format(tostring(c.enabled), tostring(c.limits and c.limits.land and c.limits.land.groups), tostring(c.groups.max_concurrent)))

do: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local g=0; local sp={}; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isWildlife(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) and u.animal.population.feature_idx==-1 and u.animal.population.cave_id==-1 then local k=u.race..':'..u.animal.population.population_idx; if not sp[k] then sp[k]=0; g=g+1 end; sp[k]=sp[k]+1 end end; local n=0; for _ in pairs(sp) do n=n+1 end; print(('eco: surface wild groups %d'):format(g))
